dependencyContract.reuseRule: Use the already-integrated shared governance audit runtime; do not create HRIS-local audit persistence, API, policy, or projection.

scope.purpose: Expose one exact, centrally authorized HCM audit handoff from the existing HRIS product-map contract while preserving every other external node as inert.
scope.mountNonclaim: HrisProductMap has no production mount. This packet does not authorize a Home mount, a new route, or a user-visible end-to-end completion claim.

forbidden: authorization bundles and generated authorization projections
audit DTO, repository, service, store, and migration files
routes, layouts, navigation manifests, and i18n resources
new /hr audit page or Home product-map mount
generic PILOT relabeling of DWP control nodes
recovery or other control evidence outside this packet

behaviorContract.allowedAction: Render Open only for this exact EXTERNAL plus CENTRAL_POLICY node when canOpenPath(exactHref) returns true, and call onOpen with the unchanged exactHref.
behaviorContract.deniedAction: When canOpenPath(exactHref) is false, keep the node visible, locked, and non-actionable.
behaviorContract.otherExternalNodes: The other five EXTERNAL nodes remain inert and href-free.
behaviorContract.catalogInvariant: Preserve 76 unique nodes and update the reviewed semantic hash only for the exact dwp-governance href delta.
behaviorContract.returnJourney: The already-integrated central HCM view keeps its fixed Back to HRIS target /hr/home. This packet records that prerequisite but cannot execute a real handoff journey before a separately authorized Work Explorer mount exists.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: dwp-governance remains EXTERNAL with externalTarget DWP_GOVERNANCE and authorization CENTRAL_POLICY; no generic PILOT relabel occurs.
Only dwp-governance receives the exact href /admin/governance/audit-overview?product=HCM&tab=overview.
The exact governed external item exposes Open only when canOpenPath authorizes the exact href and onOpen receives that unchanged href.
A denied exact href leaves the same item visible, locked, and non-actionable without leaking a fallback destination.
The other five EXTERNAL nodes stay inert; the catalog remains 76 unique nodes and its semantic hash changes only for the reviewed href delta.
The central HCM prerequisite retains the compiled Back to HRIS path /hr/home, while this result explicitly reports the real Work Explorer mount and browser handoff as pending.
The result changes exactly the four writable files and changes no backend, route, layout, i18n, generated, authorization, OpenAPI, audit-runtime, migration, activation, or recovery path.

staticChecks: ESLint only the four writable files
Prettier check only the four writable files
verificationPlan.visualRule: No production page is mounted under this authority. Preserve the existing responsive and semantic component contract and defer browser handoff evidence to the separately sealed Work Explorer mount slice.

invalidationConditions: the issued frontend base, branch, tree, clean state, or upstream exactness changes before implementation begins
the central SYS-001 runtime receipt or compatibility amendment bytes change
the exact href, dwp-governance identity, lifecycle, target, or authorization contract changes
a source path outside the four-file writable allowlist changes
a route, Home mount, backend, authorization, OpenAPI, audit runtime, migration, feature, policy, customer, or production activation is attempted
